gloss: (honorific) your name; the name of a guest

definitions.explanation: A respectful word for another person's name, used on forms, guest books and invitations, almost always as ご{芳名|ほうめい}. It is never used for one's own name.

examples.japanese: ご{芳名|ほうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{芳名帳|ほうめいちょう}→芳名帳：32214_houmeichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I signed the guest book at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{返信|へんしん}はがき→返信はがき：23662_henshinhagaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「ご{芳名|ほうめい}」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、「ご{芳|ほう}」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二重線|にじゅうせん}→二重線：10288_nijuusen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消|け}して→消す：00528_kesu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: On a reply card, you strike out the ご芳 of ご芳名 with a double line before writing your name.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{芳名|ほうめい}: your (honored) name, printed on forms and reply cards
- ⟦{芳名帳|ほうめいちょう}→芳名帳：32214_houmeichou⟧: guest book at a wedding, funeral or exhibition
- {芳名録|ほうめいろく}: register of guests' names

CULTURAL NOTE:
When answering a wedding invitation, etiquette says the guest crosses out every honorific the sender printed about them: ご{芳|ほう} of ご{芳名|ほうめい}, ご of ご⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧, ご of ご⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧. Leaving them in would be honoring oneself.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{名前|なまえ}→お名前：22188_onamae⟧: your name — the everyday polite word
- ⟦{氏名|しめい}→氏名：04033_shimei⟧: full name — neutral, on official forms
